description: Hand a consumer conversation back to the Meta Business Agent as the automatic responder, after a human agent has taken it over. Only releasing is supported here - taking control is restricted to configured escalation partners.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

to.description: Consumer's WhatsApp number in E.164 format.

name: mba_release_thread_control

outputSchema.description: Thread control action result with messaging product identifier

messaging_product.description: Messaging service used for the response. Always "whatsapp". Known values: whatsapp.

title: Release thread control
